_doc: Autonomy per activity. L0 human only, L1 agent drafts and human decides, L2 agent acts after human approval, L3 agent acts in a sandbox and human reviews the batch, L4 agent acts and reports. A level rises only after its golden-task evals hold for 4 weeks, with CTO approval. A failed eval or an incident drops it one level. High-risk paths cap at L2. Agents cannot edit this file.
